1.english_reference: The word of the LORD came also unto me

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥ י
traditions.LXX: Καὶ σὺ μὴ λάβῃς γυναῖκα ,
traditions.VUL: Et factum est verbum Dómini ad me ,
traditions.KJV: The word of the LORD came also unto me ,

traditions.WLC: לֵ אמֹֽר
traditions.LXX: λέγει Κύριος ὁ θεὸς Ἰσραήλ ,
traditions.VUL: dicens :
traditions.KJV: saying ,

2.english_reference: Thou shalt not take thee a wife ,

traditions.WLC: לֹֽא תִקַּ֥ח לְ ךָ֖ אִשָּׁ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐ γεννηθήσεται σοι υἱὸς
traditions.VUL: Non accípies uxórem ,
traditions.KJV: Thou shalt not take thee a wife ,

2.english_reference: neither shalt thou have sons or daughters in this place .

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹֽא יִהְי֤וּ לְ ךָ֙ בָּנִ֣ים וּ בָנ֔וֹת בַּ מָּק֖וֹם הַ זֶּֽה
traditions.LXX: οὐδὲ θυγάτηρ ἐν τῷ τόπῳ τούτῳ .
traditions.VUL: et non erunt tibi fílii , et fíliæ in loco isto .
traditions.KJV: neither shalt thou have sons or daughters in this place .

traditions.WLC: כִּי כֹ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה
traditions.LXX: ὅτι τάδε λέγει Κύριος
traditions.VUL: Quia hæc dicit Dóminus
traditions.KJV: For thus saith the LORD

3.english_reference: concerning the sons and concerning the daughters that are born in this place ,

traditions.WLC: עַל הַ בָּנִים֙ וְ עַל הַ בָּנ֔וֹת הַ יִּלּוֹדִ֖ים בַּ מָּק֣וֹם הַ זֶּ֑ה
traditions.LXX: περὶ τῶν υἱῶν καὶ περὶ τῶν θυγατέρων τῶν γεννωμένων ἐν τῷ τόπῳ τούτῳ ,
traditions.VUL: super fílios et fílias , qui generántur in loco isto ,
traditions.KJV: concerning the sons and concerning the daughters that are born in this place ,

3.english_reference: and concerning their mothers that bare them ,

traditions.WLC: וְ עַֽל אִמֹּתָ֞ ם הַ יֹּלְד֣וֹת אוֹתָ֗ ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ περὶ τῶν μητέρων αὐτῶν τῶν τετοκυιῶν αὐτούς ,
traditions.VUL: et super matres eórum , quæ genuérunt eos :
traditions.KJV: and concerning their mothers that bare them ,

3.english_reference: and concerning their fathers that begat them in this land ;

traditions.WLC: וְ עַל אֲבוֹתָ֛ ם הַ מּוֹלִדִ֥ים אוֹתָ֖ ם בָּ אָ֥רֶץ הַ זֹּֽאת
traditions.LXX: καὶ περὶ τῶν πατέρων αὐτῶν τῶν γεγεννηκότων αὐτοὺς ἐν τῇ γῇ ταύτῃ
traditions.VUL: et super patres eórum , de quorum stirpe sunt nati in terra hac :
traditions.KJV: and concerning their fathers that begat them in this land ;

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי כֹ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה
traditions.LXX: τάδε λέγει Κύριος
traditions.VUL: Hæc enim dicit Dóminus :
traditions.KJV: For thus saith the LORD ,

5.english_reference: Enter not into the house of mourning , neither go to lament nor bemoan them :

traditions.WLC: אַל תָּבוֹא֙ בֵּ֣ית מַרְזֵ֔חַ וְ אַל תֵּלֵ֣ךְ לִ סְפּ֔וֹד וְ אַל תָּנֹ֖ד לָ הֶ֑ם
traditions.LXX: Μὴ εἰσέλθῃς εἰς θίασον αὐτῶν , καὶ μὴ πορευθῇς τοῦ κόψασθαι , καὶ μὴ πενθήσῃς αὐτούς ,
traditions.VUL: Ne ingrediáris domum convívii , neque vadas ad plangéndum , neque consoléris eos :
traditions.KJV: Enter not into the house of mourning , neither go to lament nor bemoan them :

5.english_reference: for I have taken away my peace from this people , saith the LORD ,

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי אָסַ֨פְתִּי אֶת שְׁלוֹמִ֜ י מֵ אֵ֨ת הָ עָ֤ם הַ זֶּה֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἀφέστακα τὴν εἰρήνην μου ἀπὸ τοῦ λαοῦ τούτου .
traditions.VUL: quia ábstuli pacem meam a pópulo isto , dicit Dóminus ,
traditions.KJV: for I have taken away my peace from this people , saith the LORD , [ even ]

traditions.WLC: אֶת הַ חֶ֖סֶד וְ אֶת הָֽ רַחֲמִֽים
traditions.VUL: misericórdiam et miseratiónes .
traditions.KJV: lovingkindness and mercies .

6.english_reference: Both the great and the small shall die in this land :

traditions.WLC: וּ מֵ֨תוּ גְדֹלִ֧ים וּ קְטַנִּ֛ים בָּ אָ֥רֶץ הַ זֹּ֖את
traditions.VUL: Et moriéntur grandes et parvi in terra ista :
traditions.KJV: Both the great and the small shall die in this land :

6.english_reference: they shall not be buried , neither shall [ men ] lament for them ,

traditions.WLC: לֹ֣א יִקָּבֵ֑רוּ וְ לֹֽא יִסְפְּד֣וּ לָ הֶ֔ם
traditions.LXX: οὐ μὴ κόψονται αὐτοὺς
traditions.VUL: non sepeliéntur , neque plangéntur ,
traditions.KJV: they shall not be buried , neither shall [ men ] lament for them ,

6.english_reference: nor cut themselves , nor make themselves bald for them :

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹ֣א יִתְגֹּדַ֔ד וְ לֹ֥א יִקָּרֵ֖חַ לָ הֶֽם
traditions.LXX: οὐδὲ ἐντομίδας οὐ μὴ ποιήσουσιν καὶ οὐ ξυρηθήσονται ,
traditions.VUL: et non se incídent , neque calvítium fiet pro eis .
traditions.KJV: nor cut themselves , nor make themselves bald for them :

7.english_reference: Neither shall [ men ] tear [ themselves ] for them in mourning , to comfort them for the dead ;

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹֽא יִפְרְס֥וּ לָ הֶ֛ם עַל אֵ֖בֶל לְ נַחֲמ֣ וֹ עַל מֵ֑ת
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐ μὴ κλασθῇ ἄρτος ἐν πένθει αὐτῶν εἰς παράκλησιν ἐπὶ τεθνηκότι ·
traditions.VUL: Et non frangent inter eos lugénti panem ad consolándum super mórtuo ,
traditions.KJV: Neither shall [ men ] tear [ themselves ] for them in mourning , to comfort them for the dead ;

7.english_reference: neither shall [ men ] give them the cup of consolation to drink for their father or for their mother .

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹֽא יַשְׁק֤וּ אוֹתָ ם֙ כּ֣וֹס תַּנְחוּמִ֔ים עַל אָבִ֖י ו וְ עַל אִמּֽ וֹ
traditions.LXX: οὐ ποτιοῦσιν αὐτὸν ποτήριον εἰς παράκλησιν ἐπὶ πατρὶ καὶ μητρὶ αὐτοῦ .
traditions.VUL: et non dabunt eis potum cálicis ad consolándum super patre suo et matre .
traditions.KJV: neither shall [ men ] give them the cup of consolation to drink for their father or for their mother .

8.english_reference: Thou shalt not also go into the house of feasting , to sit with them to eat and to drink .

traditions.WLC: וּ בֵית מִשְׁתֶּ֥ה לֹא תָב֖וֹא לָ שֶׁ֣בֶת אוֹתָ֑ ם לֶ אֱכֹ֖ל וְ לִ שְׁתּֽוֹת
traditions.LXX: εἰς οἰκίαν πότου οὐκ εἰσελεύσῃ συνκαθίσαι μετ᾽ αὐτῶν τοῦ φαγεῖν καὶ πιεῖν .
traditions.VUL: Et domum convívii non ingrediáris , ut sédeas cum eis , et cómedas , et bibas :
traditions.KJV: Thou shalt not also go into the house of feasting , to sit with them to eat and to drink .

9.english_reference: For thus saith the LORD of hosts , the God of Israel ;

traditions.WLC: כִּי֩ כֹ֨ה אָמַ֜ר יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל
traditions.LXX: διότι τάδε λέγει Κύριος ὁ θεὸς Ἰσραήλ
traditions.VUL: quia hæc dicit Dóminus exercítuum , Deus Israel :
traditions.KJV: For thus saith the LORD of hosts , the God of Israel ;

9.english_reference: Behold , I will cause to cease out of this place in your eyes , and in your days ,

traditions.WLC: הִנְ נִ֨י מַשְׁבִּ֜ית מִן הַ מָּק֥וֹם הַ זֶּ֛ה לְ עֵינֵי כֶ֖ם וּ בִֽ ימֵי כֶ֑ם
traditions.LXX: Ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ καταλύω ἐκ τοῦ τόπου τούτου ἐνώπιον τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν ὑμῶν καὶ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ὑμῶν
traditions.VUL: Ecce ego áuferam de loco isto , in óculis vestris , et in diébus vestris ,
traditions.KJV: Behold , I will cause to cease out of this place in your eyes , and in your days ,

9.english_reference: the voice of mirth , and the voice of gladness ,

traditions.WLC: ק֤וֹל שָׂשׂוֹן֙ וְ ק֣וֹל שִׂמְחָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: φωνὴν χαρᾶς καὶ φωνὴν εὐφροσύνης ,
traditions.VUL: vocem gáudii et vocem lætítiæ ,
traditions.KJV: the voice of mirth , and the voice of gladness ,

9.english_reference: the voice of the bridegroom , and the voice of the bride .

traditions.WLC: ק֥וֹל חָתָ֖ן וְ ק֥וֹל כַּלָּֽה
traditions.LXX: φωνὴν νυμφίου καὶ φωνὴν νύμφης .
traditions.VUL: vocem sponsi et vocem sponsæ .
traditions.KJV: the voice of the bridegroom , and the voice of the bride .

10.english_reference: And it shall come to pass , when thou shalt shew this people all these words ,

traditions.WLC: וְ הָיָ֗ה כִּ֤י תַגִּיד֙ לָ עָ֣ם הַ זֶּ֔ה אֵ֥ת כָּל הַ דְּבָרִ֖ים הָ אֵ֑לֶּה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔσται ὅταν ἀναγγείλῃς τῷ λαῷ τούτῳ ἅπαντα τὰ ῥήματα ταῦτα ,
traditions.VUL: Et cum annuntiáveris pópulo huic ómnia verba hæc ,
traditions.KJV: And it shall come to pass , when thou shalt shew this people all these words ,

10.english_reference: and they shall say unto thee , Wherefore hath the LORD pronounced all this great evil against us ?

traditions.WLC: וְ אָמְר֣וּ אֵלֶ֗י ךָ עַל מֶה֩ דִבֶּ֨ר יְהוָ֤ה עָלֵ֨י נוּ֙ אֵ֣ת כָּל הָ רָעָ֤ה הַ גְּדוֹלָה֙ הַ זֹּ֔את
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἴπωσιν πρὸς σέ Διὰ τί ἐλάλησεν Κύριος ἐφ᾽ ἡμᾶς πάντα τὰ κακὰ ταῦτα ;
traditions.VUL: et díxerint tibi : Quare locútus est Dóminus super nos omne malum grande istud ?
traditions.KJV: and they shall say unto thee , Wherefore hath the LORD pronounced all this great evil against us ?

10.english_reference: or what [ is ] our iniquity ? or what [ is ] our sin that we have committed against the LORD our God ?

traditions.WLC: וּ מֶ֤ה עֲוֺנֵ֨ נוּ֙ וּ מֶ֣ה חַטָּאתֵ֔ נוּ אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָטָ֖אנוּ לַֽ יהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי נוּ
traditions.LXX: τίς ἡ ἀδικία ἡμῶν ; καὶ τίς ἡ ἁμαρτία ἡμῶν ἣν ἡμάρτομεν ἔναντι Κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν ;
traditions.VUL: quæ iníquitas nostra ? et quod peccátum nostrum , quod peccávimus Dómino Deo nostro ?
traditions.KJV: or what [ is ] our iniquity ? or what [ is ] our sin that we have committed against the LORD our God ?

11.english_reference: Then shalt thou say unto them

traditions.WLC: וְ אָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵי הֶ֗ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐρεῖς αὐτοῖς
traditions.VUL: Dices ad eos :
traditions.KJV: Then shalt thou say unto them ,

11.english_reference: Because your fathers have forsaken me

traditions.WLC: עַל֩ אֲשֶׁר עָזְב֨וּ אֲבוֹתֵי כֶ֤ם אוֹתִ י֙
traditions.LXX: Ἀνθ᾽ ὧν ἐνκατέλιπόν με οἱ πατέρες ὑμῶν ,
traditions.VUL: Quia dereliquérunt me patres vestri ,
traditions.KJV: Because your fathers have forsaken me ,

traditions.WLC: נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: λέγει Κύριος ,
traditions.VUL: ait Dóminus :
traditions.KJV: saith the LORD ,

11.english_reference: and have walked after other gods

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּלְכ֗וּ אַֽחֲרֵי֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ᾤχοντο ὀπίσω θεῶν ἀλλοτρίων
traditions.VUL: et abiérunt post deos aliénos ,
traditions.KJV: and have walked after other gods ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּעַבְד֖וּ ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐδούλευσαν αὐτοῖς
traditions.VUL: et serviérunt eis ,
traditions.KJV: and have served them ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשְׁתַּחֲו֣וּ לָ הֶ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ προσεκύνησαν αὐτοῖς ,
traditions.VUL: et adoravérunt eos :
traditions.KJV: and have worshipped them ,

traditions.WLC: וְ אֹתִ֣ י עָזָ֔בוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐμὲ ἐγκατέλιπον
traditions.VUL: et me dereliquérunt ,
traditions.KJV: and have forsaken me ,

11.english_reference: and have not kept my law

traditions.WLC: וְ אֶת תּוֹרָתִ֖ י לֹ֥א שָׁמָֽרוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὸν νόμον μου οὐκ ἐφυλάξαντο ,
traditions.VUL: et legem meam non custodiérunt .
traditions.KJV: and have not kept my law ;

12.english_reference: And ye have done worse than your fathers

traditions.WLC: וְ אַתֶּ֛ם הֲרֵעֹתֶ֥ם לַ עֲשׂ֖וֹת מֵ אֲבֽוֹתֵי כֶ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὑμεῖς ἐπονηρεύσασθε ὑπὲρ τοὺς πατέρας ὑμῶν ·
traditions.VUL: Sed et vos peius operáti estis quam patres vestri :
traditions.KJV: And ye have done worse than your fathers ;

12.english_reference: for , behold , ye walk every one after the imagination of his evil heart

traditions.WLC: וְ הִנְּ כֶ֣ם הֹלְכִ֗ים אִ֚ישׁ אַֽחֲרֵי֙ שְׁרִר֣וּת לִבּֽ וֹ הָ רָ֔ע
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἰδοὺ ὑμεῖς πορεύεσθε ἕκαστος ὀπίσω τῶν ἀρεστῶν τῆς καρδίας ὑμῶν τῆς πονηρᾶς
traditions.VUL: ecce enim ámbulat unusquísque post pravitátem cordis sui mali ,
traditions.KJV: for , behold , ye walk every one after the imagination of his evil heart ,

12.english_reference: that they may not hearken unto me

traditions.WLC: לְ בִלְתִּ֖י שְׁמֹ֥עַ אֵלָֽ י
traditions.LXX: τοῦ μὴ ὑπακούειν μου .
traditions.VUL: ut me non áudiat .
traditions.KJV: that they may not hearken unto me :

13.english_reference: Therefore will I cast you out of this land

traditions.WLC: וְ הֵטַלְתִּ֣י אֶתְ כֶ֗ם מֵ עַל֙ הָ אָ֣רֶץ הַ זֹּ֔את
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀπορίψω ὑμᾶς ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς ταύτης
traditions.VUL: Et eíciam vos de terra hac
traditions.KJV: Therefore will I cast you out of this land

13.english_reference: into a land that ye know not , [ neither ] ye nor your fathers

traditions.WLC: עַל הָ אָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹ֣א יְדַעְתֶּ֔ם אַתֶּ֖ם וַ אֲבֽוֹתֵי כֶ֑ם
traditions.LXX: εἰς τὴν γῆν ἣν οὐκ ᾒδειτε ὑμεῖς καὶ οἱ πατέρες ὑμῶν ,
traditions.VUL: in terram , quam ignorátis vos , et patres vestri :
traditions.KJV: into a land that ye know not , [ neither ] ye nor your fathers ;

13.english_reference: and there shall ye serve other gods day and night

traditions.WLC: וַ עֲבַדְתֶּם שָׁ֞ם אֶת אֱלֹהִ֤ים אֲחֵרִים֙ יוֹמָ֣ם וָ לַ֔יְלָה
traditions.LXX: καὶ δουλεύσετε ἐκεῖ θεοῖς ἑτέροις
traditions.VUL: et serviétis ibi diis aliénis , die ac nocte ,
traditions.KJV: and there shall ye serve other gods day and night ;

13.english_reference: where I will not shew you favour

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹֽא אֶתֵּ֥ן לָ כֶ֖ם חֲנִינָֽה
traditions.LXX: οἳ οὐ δώσουσιν ὑμῖν ἔλεος .
traditions.VUL: qui non dabunt vobis réquiem .
traditions.KJV: where I will not shew you favour .

14.english_reference: Therefore , behold , the days come , saith the LORD

traditions.WLC: לָ כֵ֛ן הִנֵּֽה יָמִ֥ים בָּאִ֖ים נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: Διὰ τοῦτο ἰδοὺ ἡμέραι ἔρχονται , λέγει Κύριος ,
traditions.VUL: Proptérea ecce dies véniunt , dicit Dóminus ,
traditions.KJV: Therefore , behold , the days come , saith the LORD ,

14.english_reference: that it shall no more be said , The LORD liveth

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹֽא יֵאָמֵ֥ר עוֹד֙ חַי יְהוָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐκ ἐροῦσιν ἔτι Ζῇ Κύριος
traditions.VUL: et non dicétur ultra : Vivit Dóminus ,
traditions.KJV: that it shall no more be said , The LORD liveth ,

14.english_reference: that brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁ֧ר הֶעֱלָ֛ה אֶת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵ אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
traditions.LXX: ὁ ἀναγαγὼν τοὺς υἱοὺς Ἰσραὴλ ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου ,
traditions.VUL: qui edúxit fílios Israel de terra Ægýpti ,
traditions.KJV: that brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt ;

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י אִם חַי יְהוָ֗ה
traditions.LXX: ἀλλά Ζῇ Κύριος
traditions.VUL: sed , Vivit Dóminus ,
traditions.KJV: But , The LORD liveth ,

15.english_reference: that brought up the children of Israel from the land of the north

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֶעֱלָ֜ה אֶת בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מֵ אֶ֣רֶץ צָפ֔וֹן
traditions.LXX: ὃς ἀνήγαγεν τὸν οἶκον Ἰσραὴλ ἀπὸ γῆς βορρᾶ
traditions.VUL: qui edúxit fílios Israel de terra aquilónis ,
traditions.KJV: that brought up the children of Israel from the land of the north ,

15.english_reference: and from all the lands whither he had driven them

traditions.WLC: וּ מִ כֹּל֙ הָֽ אֲרָצ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִדִּיחָ֖ ם שָׁ֑מָּ ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀπὸ πασῶν τῶν χωρῶν οὗ ἐξώσθησαν ἐκεῖ ·
traditions.VUL: et de univérsis terris , ad quas eiéci eos :
traditions.KJV: and from all the lands whither he had driven them :

15.english_reference: and I will bring them again into their land that I gave unto their fathers

traditions.WLC: וַ הֲשִֽׁבֹתִי ם֙ עַל אַדְמָתָ֔ ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לַ אֲבוֹתָֽ ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀποκαταστήσω αὐτοὺς εἰς τὴν γῆν αὐτῶν ἣν ἔδωκα τοῖς πατράσιν αὐτῶν .
traditions.VUL: et redúcam eos in terram suam , quam dedi pátribus eórum .
traditions.KJV: and I will bring them again into their land that I gave unto their fathers .

16.english_reference: Behold , I will send for many fishers , saith the LORD

traditions.WLC: הִנְ נִ֨י שֹׁלֵ֜חַ ל דוגים רַבִּ֛ים נְאֻם יְהוָ֖ה

traditions.VUL: Ecce ego mittam piscatóres multos , dicit Dóminus ,
traditions.KJV: Behold , I will send for many fishers , saith the LORD ,

traditions.WLC: וְ דִיג֑וּ ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἁλιεύσουσιν αὐτούς ·
traditions.VUL: et piscabúntur eos :
traditions.KJV: and they shall fish them ;

16.english_reference: and after will I send for many hunters

traditions.WLC: וְ אַֽחֲרֵי כֵ֗ן אֶשְׁלַח֙ לְ רַבִּ֣ים צַיָּדִ֔ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα ἀποστελῶ τοὺς πολλοὺς θηρευτάς ,
traditions.VUL: et post hæc mittam eis multos venatóres ,
traditions.KJV: and after will I send for many hunters ,

16.english_reference: and they shall hunt them from every mountain , and from every hill , and out of the holes of the rocks

traditions.WLC: וְ צָד֞וּ ם מֵ עַ֤ל כָּל הַר֙ וּ מֵ עַ֣ל כָּל גִּבְעָ֔ה וּ מִ נְּקִיקֵ֖י הַ סְּלָעִֽים
traditions.LXX: καὶ θηρεύσουσιν αὐτοὺς ἐπάνω παντὸς ὄρους καὶ ἐπάνω παντὸς βουνοῦ καὶ ἐκ τῶν τρυμαλιῶν τῶν πετρῶν .
traditions.VUL: et venabúntur eos de omni monte , et de omni colle , et de cavérnis petrárum .
traditions.KJV: and they shall hunt them from every mountain , and from every hill , and out of the holes of the rocks .

17.english_reference: For mine eyes [ are ] upon all their ways

traditions.WLC: כִּ֤י עֵינַ י֙ עַל כָּל דַּרְכֵי הֶ֔ם
traditions.LXX: ὅτι οἱ ὀφθαλμοί μου ἐπὶ πάσας τὰς ὁδοὺς αὐτῶν ,
traditions.VUL: Quia óculi mei super omnes vias eórum :
traditions.KJV: For mine eyes [ are ] upon all their ways :

17.english_reference: they are not hid from my face

traditions.WLC: לֹ֥א נִסְתְּר֖וּ מִ לְּ פָנָ֑ י
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐκ ἐκρύβη τὰ ἀδικήματα αὐτῶν ἀπέναντι τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν μου .
traditions.VUL: non sunt abscónditæ a fácie mea ,
traditions.KJV: they are not hid from my face ,

17.english_reference: neither is their iniquity hid from mine eyes

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹֽא נִצְפַּ֥ן עֲוֺנָ֖ ם מִ נֶּ֥גֶד עֵינָֽ י
traditions.VUL: et non fuit occultáta iníquitas eórum ab óculis meis .
traditions.KJV: neither is their iniquity hid from mine eyes .

18.english_reference: And first I will recompense their iniquity and their sin double

traditions.WLC: וְ שִׁלַּמְתִּ֣י רִֽאשׁוֹנָ֗ה מִשְׁנֵ֤ה עֲוֺנָ ם֙ וְ חַטָּאתָ֔ ם

traditions.VUL: Et reddam primum dúplices iniquitátes , et peccáta eórum :
traditions.KJV: And first I will recompense their iniquity and their sin double ;

18.english_reference: because they have defiled my land

traditions.WLC: עַ֖ל חַלְּלָ֣ ם אֶת אַרְצִ֑ י
traditions.LXX: ἐφ᾽ αἷς ἐβεβήλωσαν τὴν γῆν μου
traditions.VUL: quia contaminavérunt terram meam
traditions.KJV: because they have defiled my land ,

18.english_reference: they have filled mine inheritance with the carcases of their detestable and abominable things

traditions.WLC: בְּ נִבְלַ֤ת שִׁקּֽוּצֵי הֶם֙ וְ תוֹעֲב֣וֹתֵי הֶ֔ם מָלְא֖וּ אֶת נַחֲלָתִֽ י
traditions.LXX: ἐν τοῖς θνησιμαίοις τῶν βδελυγμάτων αὐτῶν καὶ ἐν ταῖς ἀνομίαις αὐτῶν , ἐν αἷς ἐπλημμέλησαν τὴν κληρονομίαν μου .
traditions.VUL: in morticínis idolórum suórum , et abominatiónibus suis implevérunt hereditátem meam .
traditions.KJV: they have filled mine inheritance with the carcases of their detestable and abominable things .

19.english_reference: O LORD , my strength , and my fortress , and my refuge in the day of affliction

traditions.WLC: יְהוָ֞ה עֻזִּ֧ י וּ מָעֻזִּ֛ י וּ מְנוּסִ֖ י בְּ י֣וֹם צָרָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: Κύριε , σὺ ἰσχύς μου καὶ βοήθειά μου καὶ καταφυγή μου ἐν ἡμέραις κακῶν ·
traditions.VUL: Dómine fortitúdo mea , et robur meum , et refúgium meum in die tribulatiónis :
traditions.KJV: O LORD , my strength , and my fortress , and my refuge in the day of affliction ,

19.english_reference: the Gentiles shall come unto thee from the ends of the earth

traditions.WLC: אֵלֶ֗י ךָ גּוֹיִ֤ם יָבֹ֨אוּ֙ מֵֽ אַפְסֵי אָ֔רֶץ
traditions.LXX: πρὸς σὲ ἔθνη ἥξουσιν ἀπ᾽ ἐσχάτου τῆς γῆς
traditions.VUL: ad te gentes vénient ab extrémis terræ ,
traditions.KJV: the Gentiles shall come unto thee from the ends of the earth ,

19.english_reference: and shall say , Surely our fathers have inherited lies , vanity , and [ things ] wherein [ there is ] no profit

traditions.WLC: וְ יֹאמְר֗וּ אַךְ שֶׁ֨קֶר֙ נָחֲל֣וּ אֲבוֹתֵ֔י נוּ הֶ֖בֶל וְ אֵֽין בָּ֥ ם מוֹעִֽיל
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐροῦσιν Ὡς ψευδῆ ἐκτήσαντο οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν εἴδωλα , καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ἐν αὐτοῖς ὠφέλημα .
traditions.VUL: et dicent : Vere mendácium possedérunt patres nostri , vanitátem , quæ eis non prófuit .
traditions.KJV: and shall say , Surely our fathers have inherited lies , vanity , and [ things ] wherein [ there is ] no profit .

20.english_reference: Shall a man make gods unto himself

traditions.LXX: εἰ ποιήσει ἑαυτῷ ἄνθρωπος θεούς ,
traditions.VUL: Numquid fáciet sibi homo deos ,
traditions.KJV: Shall a man make gods unto himself ,

traditions.WLC: וְ הֵ֖מָּה לֹ֥א אֱלֹהִֽים
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὗτοι οὐκ εἰσὶν θεοί ?

traditions.KJV: and they [ are ] no gods ?

traditions.WLC: לָ כֵן֙
traditions.LXX: διὰ τοῦτο
traditions.VUL: Idcírco
traditions.KJV: Therefore ,

21.english_reference: behold , I will this once cause them to know ,

traditions.WLC: הִנְ נִ֣י מֽוֹדִיעָ֔ ם בַּ פַּ֣עַם הַ זֹּ֔את

traditions.VUL: ecce ego osténdam eis per vicem hanc ,
traditions.KJV: behold , I will this once cause them to know ,

traditions.LXX: τὴν χεῖρά μου , καὶ γνωριῶ αὐτοῖς τὴν δύναμίν μου ,

traditions.KJV: I will cause them to know mine hand and my might ;

21.english_reference: and they shall know that my name [ is ] The LORD .

traditions.WLC: וְ יָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי שְׁמִ֥ י יְהוָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ γνώσονται ὅτι ὄνομά μοι Κύριος .

traditions.KJV: and they shall know that my name [ is ] The LORD .
